label: 🧭 Nearest neighbours (k-NN)
description: For each row, find its k closest rows by embedding distance. Output is a long-form (source_idx, neighbour_idx, distance, rank) DataFrame ready to feed group_aggregate or join. Distance metrics: cosine (default for sentence-transformers) or euclidean.

embedding_column.label: Embedding column
embedding_column.help: List/array column produced by embed_text or vector_similarity.

label_column.label: Label column (optional)
label_column.help: If set, neighbours' labels are surfaced in the output.
